candidates.title: ✅ The PERFECT Bench Dip!
candidates.description:
✅ The PERFECT Bench Dip Form!
1️⃣ Grip the edge of the bench — not the top or center.
2️⃣ Hands should be shoulder-width or slightly wider. Avoid placing them too far apart.
3️⃣ Keep your body close to the bench throughout the entire movement to reduce shoulder stress.
4️⃣ Pull your shoulders down (unhunch them).
5️⃣ Tuck your elbows in as much as is comfortable — don’t let them flare out too wide.

candidates.title: Learn how to dip 'right'
candidates.description:
„Right“ just refers to a more optimal technique for the 1RM Weighted Calisthenics sport. There is nothing wrong in general with the first form. To move more weight safely we want to cut ROM especially in shoulder extension to not load the end ranges of our shoulders. By compressing our chest, we achieve same shoulder depth with reduced hip/weight ROM. This technique comes with a ton more advantages that are described in my book „Understanding Calisthenics“ which is out now 📈 (link in bio)
▪️
